title: Copying large images can make Plasma freeze
line: Copying a large image together with its file name (as Gwenview does) no longer freezes Plasma while the image is transferred, when the clipboard isn't set to save images.
explanation: With 'Image data copied explicitly' off (the default), Klipper still saved items that have both text and an image (the BUG 491488 exception for spreadsheet cells), and it saved them whole: it hashed the decoded image and stored a PNG. On Wayland that means a blocking read of the image from the source app on plasmashell's main thread, so with a large image (Gwenview copies the file URL plus the image) Plasma froze until the app had encoded the PNG or the 1 s pipe timeout hit, and the app itself was kept busy encoding it. Now such items are saved with only their text formats when images aren't saved, so Klipper never requests the image. The settings tooltip that said these apps 'ignore' the setting is updated to say only their text is saved.

commits.message:
klipper: don't read image data when images aren't saved

Items with both text and an image were saved whole even with image
saving off, so the clipboard read the image from the source app and
froze Plasma until it arrived. Now only their text is saved.

BUG: 490952

media.caption: Master, Clipboard popup pinned: a Gwenview-like app copies a 4000x4000 PNG with its file URL while the pointer sweeps the list; the hover highlight stops for about a second
Patched, same steps: the entry appears at once and the highlight keeps following the pointer
Master: frames every 0.2 s right after the copy; pointer moves over entries, no highlight until the freeze ends
Patched: frames every 0.2 s right after the copy; the highlight follows the pointer in every frame
